<!-- auto-status-summary:start -->
## Automated Status Summary
#### Scope
In tools/embedding_provider.py lines 155 and 214, both OpenAIEmbeddingProvider.embed and LocalFallbackEmbeddingProvider.embed filter input texts using list comprehensions: items = [text.strip() for text in texts if text and text.strip()]. When a caller provides an iterable containing empty or whitespace-only strings (e.g. ["text", "", "more"]), dropping elements changes the returned vector count (len(response.vectors) != len(texts)), corrupting positional 1-to-1 alignment between input documents and output embedding vectors.

#### Tasks
- [x] Update OpenAIEmbeddingProvider.embed in tools/embedding_provider.py to preserve input sequence length
- [x] Update LocalFallbackEmbeddingProvider.embed in tools/embedding_provider.py to return a zero or fallback vector for empty items
- [x] Add unit tests in tests/test_main.py asserting len(resp.vectors) == len(texts) for inputs containing empty strings

#### Acceptance criteria
- [x] `pytest tests/test_main.py` passes with all tests green.
- [x] `python -c "from tools.embedding_provider import LocalFallbackEmbeddingProvider; p = LocalFallbackEmbeddingProvider(); r = p.embed(['a', '', 'b']); assert len(r.vectors) == 3"` succeeds.
- [x] Deliberate-break demonstration: re-introducing the if text.strip() filter causes `pytest tests/test_main.py` to fail on empty-item test cases, and reverting restores pass.

<!-- auto-status-summary:end -->

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Embedding results now consistently preserve the original input order.
  - Blank or whitespace-only inputs receive zero vectors while maintaining the configured dimensions.
  - Mixed inputs continue to produce one result per input, including entries filtered before processing.
  - Embedding responses now report detected vector dimensions in their metadata.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Opener recovery validation

Rebased onto current main and fixed the optional-dimension type assertions. Mocked OpenAI tests now cover mixed blank inputs, all-blank inputs, empty input, iterator input, exact vector positions, and retained nonblank text stripping. `python3 -m pytest tests/test_main.py -q`: 10 passed. `python3 -m mypy --follow-imports=silent --ignore-missing-imports tests/test_main.py`: passes; the prior tests reproduced three operator errors. Ruff and Black pass. Restoring input filtering causes four alignment tests to fail; byte restoration returns all ten to pass. The issue alignment one-liner passes.

Whitespace review finding: main already calls `text.strip()` before OpenAI embedding. Retaining stripping preserves existing behavior; the new mocked test locks this down. Active review threads require reviewer disposition; no self-resolution or merge is claimed.
